Orphaned after her father dies in the bridge explosion she was forced to set off, Maria II hides in the wagon of Maria I, whose own stage partner has just killed himself over a failed romance, and the two strangers become each other's people and a double act called "Maria and Maria".

Dying of a henchman's bullet during the escape from Rodríguez's hacienda, Florès makes Maria I promise to carry on his revolution in San Miguel, and she takes up the peasant army and the campaign on his behalf.
Maria II, reluctant to take up Florès' cause that she never shared, is pulled into it to help Maria I, and ends up supplying the bombmaking skills that save the ambushed rebels.

Balthazar is handed from Jacques' family to Marie's, then to farmhands, a bakery, Gérard, Arnold, a circus, a market auction, the miller, and finally back to Gérard for a contraband run, and is abandoned wounded in the border ambush to die among sheep.

Gérard, who takes charge of Balthazar at the bakery out of jealousy over Marie's affection, beats the donkey and prepares to bludgeon him to death, and holds Marie in a violent relationship that ends with him and his gang stripping, beating and locking her in the barn.

Jacques offers to marry Marie even after she tells him of the abuse, and tells her his father has dropped the court-ordered money, but she leaves and her mother tells him only "She's gone and will never come back."
Balthazar is worked relentlessly by the farmhands, used for bakery deliveries, then bought by the miller to pump water and mill grain, and collapses into months of illness lying immobile.

Thomas, having found the body in Maryon Park, asks Ron at the drug-drenched Thames party to come to the park as a witness and cannot get the cannabis-addled Ron to credit any of it, and is drawn into the party instead.

After Thomas enlarges the frames showing the gunman in the trees and the shape on the ground, a man follows him and looks into his car, his studio is ransacked, and every negative and print is taken except one grainy blow-up.

Thomas photographs the older man and Jane in the park as a pair of lovers and only later, in the blow-ups, sees Jane looking worriedly toward a figure with a pistol, while Jane — who chases him to his studio demanding the roll and leaves a false phone number — knew what she was in.

The two Maries systematically trade their company for meals — flirting with a man to secure a free lunch and crying when he leaves, and Marie II sitting with the butterfly collector who declares his love while she only asks him for food.
The butterfly collector professes his love to Marie II in person and then goes on declaring it over the telephone while she remains indifferent and cuts up phallic-shaped food in the apartment.

Hitler appoints Choltitz military governor expecting him to detonate the explosives rigged under the Eiffel Tower and the bridges, and Choltitz, judging Hitler insane and the war lost, gives no destruction order and surrenders the city instead.

The Allies plan to bypass Paris to avoid street-fighting while the uprising is under way, and a Resistance messenger has to cross the lines and invoke Warsaw before Bradley agrees to send Leclerc's 2nd Armored Division in.

Swedish consul Nordling talks Choltitz out of the Luftwaffe bombing of the Police Prefecture by pointing out that stray bombs would hit Notre Dame, and Choltitz accepts the Gaullist truce offer instead.

Mr. Ducasse's metal discs let him control the townspeople for one minute at a time, and he and Edgar play out the residents' relationships as miniatures on a chessboard while a monitor shows the lives being steered from the tower.

tags.role: those who will not credit it
tags.basis: Mylène asks Edgar twice to slow down as he speeds toward their seaside house, he answers that his ideas go fast when he drives fast, and the crash into the tree leaves her mute and pregnant for the rest of the film.

On Noirmoutier the shopkeeper's daughter says the newcomer scared her, the linen vendors Max and Pierre single him out in the market as someone amiss, and the hotel accuses him of killing the cat left on his doorstep.
Max and Pierre block the road and stage a fake fight so that when Edgar steps in to break it up they can throw a rigged sheet over him and demand 50 francs for tearing it.
Alma opens the unsealed letter Elisabet has written to the doctor and finds she is being 'studied' — her story of the orgy and abortion set down as material — and rounds on Elisabet for using her.
Alma, alone at the cottage with the silent Elisabet, ends up telling Elisabet's own story of the despised son back to her and has to break off insisting on her own name, denying that she is Elisabet.
Alma tells the mute Elisabet about sunbathing with Katarina, the orgy with the two boys and the abortion she still feels guilty for, to a listener who neither answers nor absolves her.

Elisabet tears up the photograph of her son that came in her husband's letter, and Alma recounts that she attempted a self-induced abortion and gave birth to a boy she despises while he craves her love.
Elisabet's husband arrives at the cottage calling for his wife, addresses Alma as 'Elisabet', and though she tells him he is mistaken they have sex.

Colonel Mathieu's paratroopers work through the FLN network by assassination and capture until they corner Ali la Pointe in his Casbah hideout and tell him he is surrounded and the organization is finished.
One of Ali la Pointe's compatriots, under torture by the French Army, gives up the location of Ali's hideout.

In the escalating exchange between pieds-noirs and locals, Djamila, Zohra and Hassiba carry bombs into European civilian spaces such as the Milk Bar Café, while the security forces answer with indiscriminate killings in the Casbah.

The Algerians of the Casbah live under French colonial administration and its paratroopers' routine torture, intimidation and murder, until the closing nationalist demonstrations show the war lost even though the battle was won.

Anders recruits Gregg, Agostino, Jean-Paul and Erich for the Rio diamond job while secretly partnered with Mary Ann, who swaps the diamonds for an empty case, so the four experts do the work and die for a purpose they were never told about.
After evading the police roadblock Erich murders his own crewmate Jean-Paul for the diamond case, and is then intercepted and murdered in turn by Milford at the meeting point.
